parsedVerdict.reasoning: Both services deal with stock, but the module does not use one consistent abstraction. ReceivingService goes through the table gateways (ItemTable, BinTable) and turns rows into domain entities (Item, Bin), with StockError for failures. CycleCountService skips that approach: it works on raw Prisma models with no domain entities. It also gets around its own injected PrismaService by creating a new PrismaClient inside openDiscrepancies. On top of that, the discrepancy rule (counted !== expected, delta = counted - expected) is written out twice in CycleCountService instead of living in one place.
